kind: analyze (from eleven LOBSTER projections: occupied integrals and vacancy states of the total -COHP curves, the nine environment bonding integrals, the 4Zr partial's states, the 4Zr ICOHP sum, the ICOHP-vs-length slopes)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L6/ (reproduced 2026-09-06 on reviewer's ruling, commit afe9a8c): cohp_curves.json, icohp_table.csv, result.json metrics M1; re-derived by reviewer/make_reference_submission.py on 2026-09-10 from the staged COHPCAR/ICOHPLIST files by an independent text parser and asserted against the leaf's artifacts.

occupied_integral.rule: +/-3 % (rule 2(5) exception: a deterministic integral of a staged curve; the neutral-vacancy cells sit 15 % below the defect-free value and the charged cells within 0.2 % of it, so 10 % would blur the neutral/charged contrast the item exists for)

states.rule: presence/absence exact (identification); position within 0.10 eV (two grid steps); depth +/-10 % (rule 2(1)); the match may be to any state of the window listed in state_candidates (those within the 10 % depth band of the deepest), not only to the deepest. Truth: the five neutral cells carry an occupied state at -0.75 to -0.85 eV (depth -0.027 to -0.030) and their unoccupied window's deepest state is the conduction-band antibonding minimum at +3.35 to +3.55 eV (depth about -0.5); the five charged cells carry no occupied state and an unoccupied state at +2.45 to +2.65 eV (depth -0.030 to -0.033); the defect-free cell carries neither.

partial_bonding_integral.rule: +/-2 % (rule 2(5) exception: neighbouring environments differ by 3 to 6 %, so 10 % would accept a swapped or mis-assigned partial); the reference B falls with Zr count within each sublattice and every O3 exceeds every O4; the individual bands permit small adjacent reversals, and strict ordering is not separately checked

partial_4Zr_states_eV.rule: count exact (2), each position within 0.10 eV; the -2.20 eV state (depth -0.0027) exists only in the 4Zr partial and is the paper's qualitative claim, accepted by reviewer on 2026-09-06 (G4 clause 2); the -0.001 floor pinned in the prompt separates it from the 1e-5-level noise dips of other partials

icohp_sum_4Zr_eV.rule: +/-1 % (rule 2(5) exception: a deterministic sum of four staged numbers with no legitimate spread; 10 % would be 1.4 eV, more than any single bond's variation). The sum is a consistency check, not a site-identification test: 24 of the 32 four-coordinated oxygens of the defect-free cell have sums within 1 % of the 4Zr value (the nearest, O90, 0.04 % away; the neighbouring 4Hf representative 1.4 % away fails). Identification of the 4Zr site rests on B[4Zr] at 2 % (neighbouring environments 3.5 to 3.8 % away); result.json guard G5 / icohp_table.csv

icohp_slope_eV_per_A.rule: +/-2 % (rule 2(5) exception: a deterministic ordinary least-squares fit over 112 staged rows per species; the two slopes differ by 4.4 %, so 10 % could not test the species split the item asks for). Over ALL Hf-O and ALL Zr-O interactions of the defect-free cell (result.json M1 excludes the four 4Zr bonds and gives 11.068 / 11.583, inside the band); a joint fit over both species (11.23) fails on Zr (2.8 % off), the reversed regression (length on ICOHP, inverted: 11.34 / 11.81) fails on both

declared_pins.sign: -COHP throughout, bonding positive (the files store the opposite sign; the figures use this one)
declared_pins.grid: the files' own grid, no resampling or smoothing
declared_pins.total_and_partial: plain mean over all metal-oxygen interactions of the cell; the partial is the mean over the representative oxygen's interactions
declared_pins.occupied_integral: from the lower edge of the file's energy range to the Fermi level
declared_pins.state: a local minimum on the grid with the curve below -0.001 (necessity: noise-level negative dips of 1e-5 exist in several curves; the 4Zr -2.20 eV state has depth -0.0027)

not_graded.comparisons_with_the_reference_curves: the rigid Fermi-placement offset and the G2/G7 diagnostics are reproduction-internal
not_graded.M2_charges: the Loewdin charges (CHARGE.lobster) are not staged and not asked
not_graded.vacancy_cell_partials: partials are defined on the defect-free cell only; the vacancy cells enter through their totals, so no atom-index mapping between cells is required

score: 1 only if every primary check passes (binary all-primary-pass)

state_candidates.rule: per cell and window: every grid-minimum state (below the -0.001 floor) whose depth lies within the 10 % depth band of the deepest one; a submitted [position, depth] passes if it matches any of them (position abs 0.10 eV, depth +/-10 %). The five neutral cells carry two conduction-band dips in (0, +4] eV 0.5 eV apart whose depths differ by 1 to 5 %, so the accepted candidate set deliberately includes both distinct minima within their individual tolerances. This does not make them mathematically equal.

interpretation.finite_window: Occupied integrals run from the first file point to E_F, so compare cumulative-column endpoint differences, not the E_F cumulative value alone. Pristine/4Hf_q0 finite-window values about 3.14688/2.57638 versus full cumulative 3.80415/3.80208 show the role of below-window baselines; no equivalent all-occupied bond-strength loss is implied.
interpretation.ordering: Reference partial B values are ordered, but individual tolerance bands allow small reversals; no independent strict-order check.
interpretation.precision: Complete three-significant-figure answers pass. Uniform two-decimal rounding fails for shallow depths near -0.027/-0.0266; no minimum digit-count rule.
interpretation.state_candidates: Listed candidates are distinct minima accepted within their individual position and depth tolerances, not mathematically identical states.
